## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages-conventional-commits-required)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm run test:unit -- --run` pass locally
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes locally (if the change touches UI/routes)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or configuration changed (README, `.env.example`, etc.)
